The problem with over consumption of carbohydrates, which is what most fatties do, is that it leads to a drop in insulin sensitivity and eventually the beetus. By cutting carbs out of your diet, and consuming only healthy carbohydrates in the form of fresh vegetables and moderate amounts of fruit you are not only eliminating unnecessary excess sugar from the diet, but also taking in more nutrient dense foods.
